create_whatsapp_adapter: create a WhatsAppAdapter instance with PlatformConfig to connect a Node.js bridge for WhatsApp messaging
connect_whatsapp_bridge: connect the WhatsApp bridge by launching a Node.js subprocess and polling until the HTTP server reports connected status
send_whatsapp_message: send a WhatsApp text message via the bridge HTTP endpoint with markdown formatting and automatic chunking for long messages
build_whatsapp_message_event: build a MessageEvent from raw bridge message data, downloading and caching media URLs and injecting document text content
format_whatsapp_message: format standard markdown text into WhatsApp-compatible syntax by converting bold, italic, strikethrough, headers, and links while protecting code blocks
